post.text:
In 2021, 42 owls in the UK died after receiving a vitamin supplement which erroneously contained 1000x the intended amount of Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine). 

Toxicology analyses traced the error to a Japanese firm, Asuka Animal Health Ltd, which had intended to replicate MVS-30, an https://t.co/4NPdIHYR02
post.author_description: GI doctor with interests in endoscopy, gut health, liver & medicine. 💜 #GITwitter #LiverTwitter #MedEd. Occasional silliness. Siau rhymes with meow 😺

description.description: A collection of owl specimens laid out on a yellow floor, each resting on a piece of white paper. A woman is seen kneeling and bowing with her head down among the rows of owls, possibly in a moment of mourning or respect for the birds.
